shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin briefly dipped below $64K amidst strategic sales and ETF concerns.
Bitcoin, ETH, and XRP whales are accumulating, signaling a late-stage bear market.
Grayscale Ethereum Staking Mini ETF updated its trust agreement for regular staking distributions.
Institutional spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded a third consecutive day of inflows this week.
US inflation and Iran risks remain in focus, adding geopolitical uncertainty to BTC price.
